note: Synthetic fixtures for the combat round. The captured packets were cut from the private capture and every packed GUID, position and clock value rewritten with the same lengths and bit layout (the generator is fixture_gen_test.go). Packets whose source says "live capture" came from the fight-check debug capture (--provoke) and were rewritten the same way; the rest whose source says hand-built come from the server's writer because no player action produced the case. The payloads carry no opcode; the opcodes are the core's numbers, before the Classic wire translation.
